General.Encyclopedia:
The Archon is a luxurious, extremely resilient mobile command center with an integrated hangar for smaller craft. You can craft it at any Mobile Vehicle Bay.

Features:
- Expandable hangar for multiple smaller craft
- Holographic sensor reconstruction
- Bioreactor
- Fish tank
- Environment map

Ratings:
- Top Speed: 26m/s
- Crush Depth: 300m
- Max Crush Depth (upgraded): 1700m
- Upgrade slots: 8
- Dimensions: 26.8m x 15.9m x 79.8m
